author: Unity
description:
Creating custom packages in Unity lets you extend the Unity Editor with project-specific tools and store them in reusable, versioned-controlled locations such as Git repositories. This makes it easy to share them across multiple projects without manual copying. 

Watch the full video linked to learn how to create, version, and reuse custom packages!

title: Create custom packages
